25.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT `schools`.`School`, `schools`.`FundingType`
FROM `schools`
JOIN `satscores` ON `schools`.`CDSCode` = `satscores`.`cds`
WHERE `schools`.`City` = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY `schools`.`CDSCode`
HAVING AVG(`satscores`.`AvgScrMath`) > 400;

stats.gold_sql: SELECT T1.sname, T2.`Charter Funding Type` FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.`District Name` LIKE 'Riverside%' GROUP BY T1.sname, T2.`Charter Funding Type` HAVING CAST(SUM(T1.AvgScrMath) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.cds) > 400
